claim_boundary: Train-only sequence assets for a provisional S2-80 design. These assets do not define approved folds, authorize training, or establish zero cross-fold similarity until the exact four-view audit passes.

sequence_policy.antibody_axis: Fab uses heavy followed by light; heavy-only/VHH uses heavy; scFv uses the fused physical chain.
sequence_policy.noncanonical_residues: Explicitly exclude a system if any required VH/fused, VL, or antigen view contains a residue outside ACDEFGHIKLMNPQRSTVWY.

similarity_policy.name: S2-80
similarity_policy.required_final_backend: exact global Needleman-Wunsch four-view cross-fold audit
